_note: Kling Elements + ElevenLabs create-voice registry. Setup: scripts/setup_all_kling_character_voices.py. Pose re-register: --refresh-poses-only (keeps kling_voice_id). Voice re-register: --refresh-voice --confirm-voice-overwrite (mints new clone). Beat Gen requires active element_id per dialogue speaker (O3 Pro + bound voice).
_image_selection_rationale: Primary: neutral or happy pose. Refer: different emotion(s). All images 1024x1024 PNG, Rule 6 compliant.
